s1.title: What is a Compounder?
s1.lead: A Compounder is a person — and a way of thinking. A Compounder doesn't work for money. They build assets that work for them.
s1.t1p: Acquires income-generating assets instead of liabilities.
s1.t2p: Every euro earned funds the next asset in the network.
s1.t3p: No get-rich-quick. Freedom is built, compounded, sustained.
s2.title: What is Compounding?
s2.lead: One asset earns enough to fund the next. The next funds another. The result is a network of assets generating income every single day of the year.
s2.note: One Compounder Machine → cashflow → the next Compounder Machine.
s3.title: What is a Compounder Machine?
s3.lead: An automated asset engineered for long-term cashflow. The first Compounder Machine is an outdoor self-service laundromat — but the idea is bigger than washing. We're creating a new category.
s3.n1: An outdoor kiosk — no building required
s3.n4: The customer drives straight to the service
s4.title: Real. Stable. Efficient.
s4.t1p: Physical infrastructure you own — not a paper promise.
s4.t2p: Daily, year-round cashflow from an everyday need.
s4.t3p: Minimal operation. The machine works so you don't have to.
s5.title: Two ways to compound.
s5.r1p: Doesn't care about a washing machine. Cares about yield and growth — building assets, generating cashflow, scaling a portfolio toward freedom.
s5.r2p: More than a reseller. Operates their own machines, distributes Compounder Machines, and helps create new Compounders.
s6.title: The Compounder Card
s6.lead: A metal card. Your ticket into the Compounder ecosystem.
s6.hint: Tap the card to turn it over

p.par.title: Compounder Machine
p.par.lead: An outdoor automated asset — specs below are for the most common version, Compounder 3. Parameters are indicative; final spec per configuration.

p.par.payv: Coins, banknotes, card, tokens, loyalty app
p.par.conv: Steel frame (stainless steel optional), sandwich-plastic cladding in any standard RAL colour
p.conn.title: What the location needs
p.conn.lead: The Compounder Machine sits on a paved surface; parking in the immediate vicinity is one of the most important factors. What the location needs:
p.conn.parkp: Parking in the immediate vicinity is one of the most important factors — customers drive straight to the service.
p.conn.waterp: Standard water connection, approx. 3/4". Heating is handled by the machine.
p.conn.elp: 400 V / approx. 3×25 A. Exact load per configuration.
p.conn.drainp: Ideally DN 110 mm. Connection to sewerage or a tank.
p.conn.netp: Not included — set up a local data SIM and insert it into the router the Compounder is equipped with.
p.conn.note: Connection costs are highly individual; the average is included in the economics model.
